➡️PREVENTION MYTHS

MYTH:
Wearing masks will reduce O2 and cause CO2 poisoning.

FACT:
Masks DON'T affect the O2-CO2 gas exchange at all. Masks won't reduce the oxygen or increase CO2 in your blood.

#MaskUpIndia

FACT:
Lemon juice is acidic. Taking undiluted lemon juice through the nose will damage the inner lining, cause irritation, and may cause bleeding as well. It will not kill the virus either. DON'T SNORT LEMON JUICE.

➡️TESTING MYTHS

MYTH:
RTPCR cannot detect variants. It is useless.

RTPCR is still the Gold Standard test. It can give false negatives like any test. RTPCR tests for 2-3 different genes. Point mutations cannot cause the virus to escape the test.

➡️TREATMENT MYTHS (😭😭😭)

MYTH:
Acupressure on the palm will increase oxygen levels.

FACT: No. It won't. In COVID, the lungs are affected. Hence oxygen in the blood goes down. Acupressure on the palm won't increase O2.

Camphor-ajwain potli will increase oxygen.
